correctness.rationale: Unbiasedness uses uniform marginals, and inter-panel independence yields n^(-2beta-2) times the sum of exact nonnegative within-panel variances. For beta>-1/2, a centered midpoint Taylor expansion gives v_k = beta^2(beta-1)^2 (k+1/2)^(2beta-4)/720 + O((k+1/2)^(2beta-6)), where Var((U-1/2)^2)=1/180. Summation proves convergent series for beta<3/2, (log n)/(1280n^5) at beta=3/2, and beta^2(beta-1)^2/[720(2beta-3)] n^-5 above it, excluding the identically zero beta=0,1. The first panel gives infinite second moment for -1<beta<=-1/2. Independent-point comparator has first-derivative coefficient beta^2/12 and crossover beta=1/2. Strict countermonotone rearrangement proves optimal within independent two-uniform-marginal equal-weight panel couplings, not across panels. Uniform C^2 Taylor error gives curvature integral /720. Source verify.py checks exact beta=0,1,2,3 finite-n identities plus deterministic sampled large-cell coefficients; these do not prove all-beta limits.
